title: Plan Change Allowances Across the Patient Payment Plan Family
content:
A signed Patient Payment Plan can change in four ways during its life: new charges added on, the installment and term modified at the patient's request, an installment deferred as a payment holiday, or the agreement cancelled by the patient. The matrix gives each tier's allowance.

## Add-ons and modifications

| Tier | New eligible charges may be added | How an add-on is absorbed | Most add-ons to one plan | Installment and term may be modified at the patient's request | Most modifications of one plan | Most months a modification or an extend-term add-on may add beyond the term |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan | No | None | 0 | No | 0 | 0 |
| Standard 6-Month Payment Plan | Yes | Recalculate payment | 2 | No | 0 | 0 |
| Extended 10-Month Payment Plan | Yes | Recalculate payment | 3 | Yes | 1 | 2 |
| Long-Term 12-Month Payment Plan | Yes | Recalculate payment | 3 | Yes | 1 | 2 |
| Large-Balance 18-Month Payment Plan | Yes | Extend term | 4 | Yes | 1 | 3 |
| Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan | Yes | Extend term | 4 | Yes | 2 | 6 |

"Recalculate payment" keeps the same end date and sets a new installment; "extend term" keeps the same installment and adds months, up to the extension cap in the last column.

## Payment holidays and cancellation

| Tier | Installments that may be deferred to the end of the plan in any rolling 12 months | Calendar days before the due date by which a holiday must be requested | Remaining balance returns to regular statements when the patient cancels |
|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan | 0 | 0 (not offered) | Yes |
| Standard 6-Month Payment Plan | 0 | 0 (not offered) | Yes |
| Extended 10-Month Payment Plan | 0 | 0 (not offered) | Yes |
| Long-Term 12-Month Payment Plan | 1 | 5 | Yes |
| Large-Balance 18-Month Payment Plan | 1 | 5 | Yes |
| Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan | 2 | 5 | Yes |

## Notes

- The Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan takes no add-ons and no modifications; the Standard 6-Month Payment Plan takes add-ons but no modifications.
- Payment holidays exist only on the Long-Term, Large-Balance and Hardship tiers.
